definitions.explanation: To walk around without a specific destination, often for leisure or to kill time.
To spend time in an area without doing anything particular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぶらついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: On my days off, I wander around the neighborhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぶらついて⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つぶした。
examples.english: I killed time wandering around the department store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぶらついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧たち。
examples.english: Young people hanging around in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぶらついて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I was hanging around the park because I had nothing to do.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧もしないでぶらついて⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: They just hang around without working.

notes:
ぶらつく is an informal verb describing aimless wandering or hanging around. It comes from the onomatopoeia ⟦ぶらぶら→ぶらぶら：05167_burabura⟧ (dangling, swinging loosely), suggesting a relaxed, unhurried movement.

Related expressions:
- ⟦ぶらぶら→ぶらぶら：05167_burabura⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: similar meaning, to loaf around
- ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧: to take a walk (more purposeful)

While often neutral, ぶらつく can have slightly negative connotations when describing someone who should be doing something productive.
